source.method: Github HTML topic review, GitHub repository search, repository metadata API, package.json checks and targeted README/docs inspection. Related repositories searched beyond topic where needed.
source.scope: Curated selection; not an exhaustive crawl of the HTML topic

evaluation_method.stars: Snapshot retrieved 2026-11-16 from the repository API; fluctuates over time
evaluation_method.last_update: last_repository_push_at is GitHub pushed_at, not proof of latest published stable release
evaluation_method.maintained: archived status and last push reviewed; vulnerabilities, maintainer bus factor and release cadence were not fully audited
evaluation_method.score_scale: 1=poor, 5=excellent. Editorial scores are fit-for-purpose judgments, not GitHub data.
evaluation_method.unknown_values: null denotes not verified; missing manifest inspection is not equivalent to having no dependencies
evaluation_method.security_and_performance: No independent security scan, dependency advisory query, bundle measurement, or Lighthouse run was performed.
evaluation_method.rankings_context: Ranked for lightweight, maintainable, publicly served static sites; not for a complex application backend.

global_integration_notes.pages_static_only: No PHP, Ruby application server, Node server, database, private API, or custom server-rendered routes execute at request time on ordinary GitHub Pages.
global_integration_notes.project_pages_paths: For project sites served under /repo-name/, relative URLs or configured base paths are needed to prevent broken assets.
css_conflicts: Use just one primary CSS framework
Do not layer Bootstrap and Bulma grids/reset defaults
HyperUI markup requires compiled compatible Tailwind
javascript_conflicts: Avoid loading overlapping UI JS frameworks
Use Alpine/Bootstrap JS only for needed behaviors
Do not ship testing CLIs as browser bundles
seo_conflicts: Do not duplicate canonical or Open Graph tags when using jekyll-seo-tag
Use one sitemap generator or single authored sitemap
Canonical origin must match deployment URL
global_integration_notes.forms_and_data: HTML forms can render but require a separately hosted form processor/service to receive submissions. Never embed confidential keys.
global_integration_notes.license_policy: A GitHub API license of NOASSERTION or null is recorded as spdx_id null; review redistribution terms before reuse.
global_integration_notes.security_policy: Metadata and README inspection are not a dependency or vulnerability audit; pin versions, use trusted assets and review advisories before production.
global_integration_notes.performance_policy: Use Lighthouse and real device testing; no performance score, benchmark or bundle measurement was invented.
